title: Maths reference: Year 7 Space
summary: The words and methods from Year 7 Space, each with an example and, where it helps, a picture of the board.
_about: Maths cards for maths/space-7 (see snippets/maths-algebra-7.json for the format; split from the strand courses' card files on 1 Nov 2026).

items.label: triangles by sides and angles
items.hint: Give two names: one for the sides (how many are equal) and one for the biggest angle. Equal sides sit opposite equal angles.
items.board:
widget: geometry
shape: triangle
corners: 2,1; 8,1; 5,5
classify: on
sum: off
items.shows: An isosceles acute triangle, its equal sides ticked

items.label: quadrilateral family
items.code: \text{every square is a rectangle; every rectangle is a parallelogram}
items.hint: Trapezium: at least one pair of parallel sides. Parallelogram: two. Rhombus: four equal sides. Rectangle: four right angles. Square: both. Kite: two pairs of equal neighbouring sides. A square is also a rectangle and a rhombus.
items.board:
widget: geometry
shape: polygon
sides: 4
corners: 3,1; 7,1; 7,5; 3,5
classify: on
sum: off
items.shows: A square with equal sides, parallel sides and right angles marked

items.label: regular polygon
items.hint: Both are needed: a rhombus has equal sides but is not regular. Names: pentagon 5, hexagon 6, heptagon 7, octagon 8, nonagon 9, decagon 10.

items.label: convex and concave
items.hint: Convex: every corner points out. Concave: at least one corner points in.
items.board:
widget: geometry
shape: polygon
sides: 6
corners: 2,1; 7,1; 9,4; 6,3; 4,6; 1,4
classify: on
sum: off
items.shows: A concave hexagon with one corner pointing in

items.label: net
items.hint: A net is a solid unfolded flat. Fold it, or roll a cube over it, to check that every face is covered once. Six squares is not enough.
items.shows: A cross of six squares that folds into a cube

items.label: prism net area
items.hint: A triangular prism has two triangles and three rectangles. The net's area is the surface area.

items.label: top, front and side views
items.hint: A view shows what you can see from one side; hidden cubes do not show. The top view with heights shows every cube.
items.shows: Three drawings of the same cubes

items.label: translation
items.hint: Every point slides the same way. Right and up add; left and down take away.
items.board:
widget: transform
mode: translate
shape: 1,1; 3,1; 3,2
range: 8
dx: 3
dy: -2
items.shows: A triangle moved 3 right and 2 down

items.label: reflection
items.hint: Each point and its image are the same distance from the mirror, on opposite sides.
items.board:
widget: transform
mode: reflect
shape: 2,1; 4,1; 4,3
range: 6
axis: y
items.shows: A triangle reflected in the y-axis

items.label: rotation
items.hint: Give the centre, the angle and the direction. A half turn: (x, y) to (−x, −y). 90° clockwise is 270° anticlockwise.
items.board:
widget: transform
mode: rotate
shape: 2,1; 4,1; 4,2
range: 6
t: 90
items.shows: A triangle turned a quarter turn about the origin

items.label: algorithm
items.hint: A set of steps and decisions that gives the right result every time. Test it on one shape of every class.
